hooks.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -er '.cwd'); root=$(git -C "$cwd" rev-parse --show-toplevel); printf '%s' "$input" | bash "$root/.codex/hooks/format-go.sh"
